agent_assessment.summary: Investigation into Case HHG-015 reveals high-risk indicators. Customer C03042 attempted an online transaction of $599.94, which significantly exceeds their historical average of $144.57 and matches their historical maximum. The model risk score is 0.77. Crucially, the customer has a documented history of confirmed fraud (67% historical fraud rate across prior cases involving card-not-present unauthorized activity). Although the billing region has been used before and a desktop device was identified, the combination of high transaction value, online channel, and strong historical fraud precedent necessitates immediate escalation and block.
